title: Store tests are table-driven with controllable clocks
content: TEST CONVENTION: Store/session tests are TABLE-DRIVEN (one test function, cases in a slice) and use the store.now func field as the controllable clock. Established in expiry_table_test.go. New handler/store test tables (lookup tables, admin tables) MUST follow the same shape; a pile of separate test functions for related cases is a review blocker.
